answer: Bind each session key to one unit of work. Rotate at 200 attestations; the old key stays auditable but cannot sign new claims. Weight a claim by the number of independent paths that carried it, so a marble copy of a known trace adds nothing. When an audit fails, the lantern goes out for that key only and the identity keeps its history. Maintainer note: the key-to-work map lives in the epoch record, so replay is a table lookup. A comet of fresh keys buys no weight, since path length only grows with outside confirmations.
